description: This Java class defines `ViaNode`, a subclass of `PcbNode`, representing a via point in a PCB layout with properties such as location, size, and net identifier. It provides methods for initialization, string representation, and connectivity checks.

classes.name: ViaNode
classes.description: Represents a via node in a PCB layout, including its location, size, and associated net ID.

methods.name: ViaNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a ViaNode instance using provided node name, index, and children nodes. It locates and assigns location, size, and netId.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ViaNode, including its location.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if a given point is connected to this via's location, considering size.
